[[Bezzr Wingstorm]] is a [[Mantis]] [[boss]] that is found in [[Drazach Thicket]].

==Locations==
* [[Echovald Forest]]
** {{NPC location|Drazach Thicket}}

==Skills==
15 [[Illusion Magic]] (20 Illusion Magic in [[Hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Accumulated Pain}}
* {{skill icon|Conjure Nightmare}}
* {{skill icon|Crippling Anguish}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
* {{skill icon|Fragility}}

==Items dropped==
* [[Amber Chunk]]
* [[Mantis Pincer]]
* [[Monstrous Eye]]
* [[Ruby]]
* [[Wingstorm]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
* Bezzr Wingstorm appears to be alone, but several Mantises will [[popup]] when you approach; the boss can be [[pull]]ed with a [[longbow]] or [[flatbow]]. 
* The easiest route is from [[the Eternal Grove (outpost)|the Eternal Grove]], but it will always be through Kurzick territory.
* Although Wingstorm requires 9 [[Domination Magic]], Bezzr does not use skills of that attribute. 
* Some players consider the 200 [[wanding]] damage done by this Mesmer boss in [[Hard mode]] to be abnormally strong.
